summary: Owner-reported: the packaged Tauri app had no working runtime model API. Resolve the provider key from the user data directory (plus explicit file/env/checkout), keep the usage ledger and DEV_MODE in the data dir instead of the frozen bundle, add a same-origin GET/POST /api/settings endpoint that stores the key 0600 without echoing it, and add a header settings dialog so the approved AI operations (daily triage, QA, vision, translate) are reachable again through the single budget gateway.
scope_note: Owner request 2026-09-20: '现在的tauri的app版本很多地方没接入api，把api正常接进去'. This completes AI-01 key provisioning for the desktop shell. It adds no new prompt, model, operation or ceiling, sends no private seed/profile IDs, keeps the local-only default when no key is configured, and makes no live provider call in this work unit.

budget_impact.rationale: harness/budget.json is unchanged: no new operation, prompt, retry or cap. Before the change the desktop app could not load the already-approved key at all, so daily_triage/paper_qa/paper_vision_qa degraded to local mode; afterwards they are reachable under the same approved ceilings through the one gateway. Usage is now recorded in the user data directory, so the daily/monthly reservations actually apply instead of silently failing on a read-only bundle path.
budget_impact.before: Desktop shell: DEEPSEEK_API_KEY removed from the child env and .local/deepseek.env resolved against CWD (~/Library/Application Support/PaperDigHelper), so /api/translate and /api/qa returned 'no API key' and the ledger resolved inside the .app bundle. Registered operations unchanged: daily_triage, paper_qa, selection_translate, paper_vision_qa, llm_rerank(off), weekly_digest(off), query_expand(off).
budget_impact.after: Key resolved from PAPERDIGHELPER_KEY_FILE, environment, <data_dir>/deepseek.env, <root>/.local/deepseek.env (checkout legacy) or <data_dir>/.local/deepseek.env. Same registered operations and same ceilings; ledger and DEV_MODE under the data dir. No key -> unchanged local degradation. No change to any cap, price or scenario in budget.json.
budget_impact.developer_usage: unknown; agent-host token consumption is not controlled by harness/budget.json

open_risks: The rebuilt .app was ad-hoc signed for local use only, not notarized; the running instance keeps the pre-fix code until relaunched.
No independent review yet; critical class requires one before release.
No live provider call was made, so key validity, DeepSeek contract/pricing freshness and real tokenizer parity remain unverified.
runtime_enforcement_implemented and tokenizer_parity_verified remain false in harness/budget.json; release checks stay blocked.
The change record also covers the pre-existing uncommitted organization/Tauri work already present in the worktree; this review does not certify that older work.
